pages.title: The Tide Remembers
paragraphs: Three moons have passed since her husband's ship slipped beneath a starless sky. The last letter to reach Maria spoke of an island on no chart: {island}, where the fog hums like a choir and the tide runs the color of old wine.
She has bought passage on a lone merchant ship, and tonight, in the dead hour, black sails slide out of the mist. Bartz and his pirates have come to board.
Whatever waits on {island} will have to wait a little longer.

pages.title: The Weapon Triangle
paragraphs: Weapons have a rivalry. Maria's Rapier is a Sword, and Swords beat Axes, which is what these raiders carry.
With weapon advantage, Maria gains {hit} Hit and {avoid} Avoid and deals {damage} more damage. With disadvantage she suffers the same penalties, so choose your fights.

pages.title: Healing Potions
paragraphs: Battle leaves its mark. Maria carries a Potion that restores {heal} HP.
Select a wounded unit, open Inventory from the action menu and press Use on the Potion. Using an item takes that unit's action, and a Potion has {uses} uses before it is gone.

pages.title: Stairs
paragraphs: The cursor marks a flight of stairs. A unit standing on stairs gains {bonus}, making it harder to hit.
Move the cursor over any tile to read its bonuses, then use the ground to your advantage.
